title: An ask's to= and an answer's ref= session id show as the session's label in kbmon, not the all-zero placeholder
goal: kbmon's coord panel and coord status show a session id in an ask's to field and an answer's ref field as the same s- label the holder and session fields get, so one session has one label in every field

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,uuid
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import mon_view
st=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'c.sqlite');g=str(uuid.uuid4())
s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','--store',st,'post','--kind','ask','--field','to='+g,'--field','id=AQ-aaaaaaaa','--field','ref=ask/AQ-aaaaaaaa'],capture_output=True,check=True)
o=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--json','--panel','coord','--store',st],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120).stdout
lab=mon_view.session_label(g);print(lab, lab in o, g in o);sys.exit(0 if lab in o and g not in o else 1)
